title: Requirements specification
outcome: Specify what the solution must do, from business requirements through functional requirements to detailed use cases, ready for design and build.

minimumInputs.help: What has already been confirmed with stakeholders?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices over 10,000 need director approval; all approvals must be logged.

minimumInputs.help: What does this cover, and what is outside it?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice approval in the new workflow; payment runs are outside.

minimumInputs.help: Who has a say in the requirements?
minimumInputs.example: Finance director, AP lead, approving managers, IT.

minimumInputs.help: Any terms or abbreviations that need defining? Say "none" if not.
minimumInputs.example: AP means accounts payable; PO means purchase order.

minimumInputs.help: What business need do these requirements serve?
minimumInputs.example: Reduce approval time and payment errors.

minimumInputs.help: What result do you want this work to deliver?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved within five days and fewer supplier complaints.

minimumInputs.help: What is the initiative, and where does it start and stop?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice approval workflow; finance system changes are out.

minimumInputs.prompt: Known stakeholder needs or explicit hypotheses
minimumInputs.help: What do stakeholders need? Mark anything you have not confirmed as a guess.
minimumInputs.example: Managers need approvals on phones (confirmed); auditors need a trail (assumed).

minimumInputs.help: What need does this cover, and what is out of scope?
minimumInputs.example: Approval routing; supplier onboarding is out.

minimumInputs.help: Who or what interacts with the system?
minimumInputs.example: Manager, AP clerk, finance system.

minimumInputs.help: What must the system do, and who said so?
minimumInputs.example: Route invoices over 10,000 to a director (finance policy).

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Anything not yet decided is listed as an open gap, not filled in for you.
Who (or what system) carries out this use case?
minimumInputs.example: An approving manager.

minimumInputs.help: What is the actor trying to achieve?
minimumInputs.example: Approve an invoice that is within their spending limit.

minimumInputs.help: What does this cover, and what is outside it?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice approval in the new workflow; payment runs are outside.

minimumInputs.help: Describe the normal steps, and any conditions you know (before, after, exceptions).
minimumInputs.example: Manager opens invoice, checks it against the order, approves; invoices over the limit go to a director.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Any step Kryterea proposes rather than takes from you is marked as proposed.
What does the solution cover, and where does it stop?
minimumInputs.example: The approval web app and its email notifications.

minimumInputs.help: Who uses it, what data does it handle, and where or when does it run?
minimumInputs.example: Around 40 managers, invoice and supplier data, used in office hours across two countries.

minimumInputs.help: Which qualities matter most, such as speed, security, availability or accessibility?
minimumInputs.example: Security of supplier bank details, and pages loading in under two seconds.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Any number you have not given (for example a response time) is proposed and marked for confirmation.
What software is being specified, and what is excluded?
minimumInputs.example: The approval web app; the finance system is excluded.

minimumInputs.help: Who uses it, and which systems does it connect to?
minimumInputs.example: Managers and AP clerks; connects to the finance system and email.

minimumInputs.prompt: Sourced behaviour and quality constraints or explicit gaps
minimumInputs.help: What must it do and how well, with where each came from? Say what is still unknown.
minimumInputs.example: Approve in two clicks (managers); 99.5% uptime (IT); load times unknown.

minimumInputs.prompt: Known requirements or draft statements with identifiers
minimumInputs.help: Paste the requirements you have, with IDs if they have them.
minimumInputs.example: REQ-1 route by amount; REQ-2 log every approval.

minimumInputs.help: What does the solution cover?
minimumInputs.example: Invoice capture, approval and posting.

minimumInputs.help: Which viewpoints matter (business, user, technical) and what constraints apply?
minimumInputs.example: Audit trail for finance; mobile for managers; reuse company login.
